# LaptopRent Online — Laptop Rentals & Hardware Leasing in India

- **Developer Workstations:** Apple MacBook Pro (M1/M2/M3, 16GB–64GB RAM), ThinkPad P-series, Dell XPS 15.
- **Business Laptops:** Dell Latitude, Lenovo ThinkPad T14, HP EliteBook from ₹849/month.

- **Corporate Bulk Leasing:** Pre-configured corporate laptops with MDM/antivirus and customized OS provisioning for engineering teams.

- **Pricing:** Flexible monthly tenure starting at ₹849/month.
